01

“We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:3).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God [al-Zumar 3] he said: "This is what Quraysh say of the idols, and those before them said it of the angels, Jesus, and Ezra."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى [الزمر: 3] قَالَ: " هَذَا قَوْلُ قُرَيْشٍ تَقُولُهُ لِلْأَوْثَانِ، وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُمْ يَقُولُونَهُ: لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَلِعِيسَى وَلِعُزَيْرٍ "
Edition record 373225 · p. 577Link to report ↗
02

“He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:5).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night [al-Zumar 5] he said: "He rolls the night over the day and rolls the day over the night."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ [الزمر: 5] قَالَ: «يُدَهْوِرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ، وَيُدَهْوِرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ»
Edition record 373226 · p. 577Link to report ↗
03

“and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:6).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates [al-Zumar 6] meaning: "from camels, cattle, sheep, rams, and goats."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ [الزمر: 6] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنَ الْإِبِلِ وَالْبَقَرِ وَالْغَنَمِ وَالضَّأْنِ وَالْمَاعْزِ»
Edition record 373227 · p. 577Link to report ↗
04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
creation after creation [al-Zumar 6] he said: "a drop, then a clinging clot, then a lump, then bone, until his creation is complete."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
خَلْقًا مِنْ بَعْدِ خَلَقٍ [الزمر: 6] قَالَ: «نُطْفَةً، ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً، ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً، ثُمَّ عَظْمًا حَتَّى يَتِمَّ خَلْقُهُ»
Edition record 373228 · p. 577Link to report ↗

in three darknesses [al-Zumar 6] he said: "the darkness of the belly, the womb, and the placenta."
العربية
الإسناد

فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ [الزمر: 6] ، قَالَ: «ظُلْمَةُ الْبَطْنِ، وَالرَّحِمِ، وَالْمَشِيمَةِ»

04

“during periods of the night”

An explanation transmitted from al-Ḥasan.

06
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 06

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, on His words:
during periods of the night [Al Imran 113] meaning: "the hours of the night: its beginning, middle, and end."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ [آل عمران: 113] ، يَعْنِي: «سَاعَاتِ اللَّيْلِ أَوَّلِهِ وَأَوْسَطِهِ وَآخِرِهِ»

08

“Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:24).

10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [al-Zumar 24] he said: "he will be dragged on his face in the Fire." It is like His words: "Then is he who is cast into the Fire better, or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection?"
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ [الزمر: 24] قَالَ: «يُجَرُّ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي النَّارِ» . وَهُوَ كَقَوْلِهِ أَفَمَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَمَّنْ يَأْتِي آمِنًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
Edition record 373234 · p. 578Link to report ↗

10

“God presents an example: a man in whom are quarreling partners, and…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:29).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
God presents an example: a man in whom are quarreling partners, and a man belonging exclusively to one man [al-Zumar 29] he said: "the likeness of the false gods and the God of truth."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فِيهِ شَرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ [الزمر: 29] وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ قَالَ: «مَثَلُ آلِهَةِ الْبَاطِلِ وَإِلَهِ الْحَقِّ»
Edition record 373236 · p. 579Link to report ↗

14

“And when God is mentioned alone, shrink”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:45).

16
Explanation from Mujāhid 16

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And when God is mentioned alone, shrink [al-Zumar 45] meaning: "contract," the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter [al-Zumar 45]: "that was the day the Messenger of God ﷺ recited Sura al-Najm at the door of the Kaba."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:

Edition record 373240 · p. 579Link to report ↗

“O My servants who have transgressed against themselves”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:53).

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [al-Zumar 53] meaning: "those who killed people in the pre-Islamic period."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ [الزمر: 53] ، يَعْنِي: «مَنْ قَتَلَ الْأَنْفُسَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»

Explanation from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
"Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to God" meaning: "what I wasted of God's command."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:

Further reports

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Wahb ibn Munabbih and Zayd ibn Aslam.

21
Explanation from Mujāhid 21

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
"To Him belong the keys [maqalid] of the heavens" meaning: "the keys of the heavens; it is a Persian word."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَوَاتِ ، يَعْنِي: «مَفَاتِيحَ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَهِيَ بِالْفَارِسِيَّةِ»
Edition record 373245 · p. 580Link to report ↗
22
Report from Wahb ibn Munabbih 22

Wahb ibn Munabbih

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Ibn Abi Shayban, from Wahb ibn Munabbih, who said:
"All creation, the heavens and the earths, in the grasp of God, Mighty and Majestic, is only like a mustard seed here in the hand of one of you, at the second joint on the inside of the ring finger."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ:
«مَا الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُونَ فِي قَبْضَةِ اللَّهِ عز وجل إِلَّا كَخَرْدَلَةٍ هَا هُنَا مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ فِي الْعِقْدِ الثَّانِي مِنْ بَاطِنِ الْبِنْصِرِ»
Edition record 373246 · p. 580Link to report ↗

24
Report from Zayd ibn Aslam 24

Zayd ibn Aslam

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Umar al-Sanani related to us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, who said:
"Those whom God, Mighty and Majestic, excepted are twelve: Gabriel, Michael, Israfil, the angel of death, and the eight bearers of the Throne."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا أَبُو عُمَرَ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ:
" الَّذِينَ اسْتَثْنَى اللَّهُ عز وجل اثْنَا عَشَرَ: جِبْرِيلُ، وَمِيكَائِيلُ، وَإِسْرَافِيلُ، وَمَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ، وَحَمَلَةُ الْعَرْشِ ثَمَانِيَةٌ "

“Peace be upon you; you have become pure”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 39:73).

25
Explanation from Mujāhid 25

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Peace be upon you; you have become pure [al-Zumar 73] meaning: "you were good through obedience to God, Mighty and Majestic."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ [الزمر: 73] ، يَعْنِي: «كُنْتُمْ طَيِّبِينَ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ عز وجل»
